title.en: Face isometry and hinge coincidence during unfolding

summary: Verify that folding preserves within-face distances and areas while hinge endpoints stay coincident throughout the motion.
objective: Face measurements are constant across the fold, hinge endpoints never separate, and the flat and closed states meet their overlap and seam conditions.
applies_when: A polyhedron unfolds to a planar net or folds back along a hinge tree.
Panels are treated as zero-thickness mathematical faces.
A viewer can stop the motion anywhere between flat and closed.
intent_signals: check that this net closes into the solid
example_prompts: Check that this cube net folds without stretching its faces.

principles: Folding is an isometry of each face: within a face every pairwise distance and the area are invariants throughout the motion, and only dihedral angles change.
A hinge is a shared edge, so its endpoints must coincide for both faces at every instant; the check belongs on endpoint positions rather than on the rendered seam.
A valid net is a claim about one specific adjacency tree; the existence of unfoldings in general does not make an arbitrary authored tree fold to the target solid.
implementation: Sample the fold parameter at ten values from flat to closed and, at each, compute for every face its corner-to-corner distances and its area.
For every hinge compute the distance between the two faces copies of each shared endpoint at the same samples.
At the flat configuration compute pairwise interior overlap area, and at the closed configuration compute the gap between every pair of seam edges that should meet.
Record the fold parameter alongside every measurement so a failure identifies where in the motion it appears.
observable_checks: Within-face distances and areas are constant across all samples to the precision of the geometry; a drifting value means vertices are being moved independently rather than by a rigid face transform.
Hinge endpoint separation stays at zero within the tolerance declared from the model scale; separation that grows with the fold angle points at an incorrect rotation axis.

The flat state shows zero interior overlap area and the closed state has all seam gaps within tolerance; a net failing either is reported as not folding to the target instead of being nudged visually.

known_limits: Treats panels as zero-thickness faces; sheet thickness, material behaviour and fabrication allowances are outside this check.
Authored verification guidance; no computation or render was run for this record.
creative_affordances: Adapt the scenario, scale and presentation to your subject; this record fixes what must be checked, not how the scene must look.
